description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential leadership opportunity is for a professional committed to excellence in patient care and operational management.The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of facility operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and fostering a positive environment for residents and staff. This role offers a competitive salary for a leader ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Current and active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Ability to effectively manage financial, operational, and clinical aspects of the facility
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
